questions.q: In how many different ways can the letters of the word CANCER be arranged?
questions.why: 6 letters with repeats: 6! ÷ 2! = 360. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: What comes next? HIJ, LMN, PQR, TUV, …
questions.why: Each group starts 4 letters after the last one, with the same pattern inside: XYZ. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: If 23 May 2024 was a Thursday, what day of the week was 10 July 2024?
questions.why: 48 days later; 48 mod 7 = 6, so count 6 days on from Thursday. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Statement: Should a legally enforceable 'Right to Disconnect' ban companies from contacting employees outside working hours? Arguments: I. Yes. Constant availability causes burnout, harms mental health and lowers long-term productivity. II. No. In a global economy across time zones, a rigid ban will hurt competitiveness and growth.
opts: Neither I nor II is strong
Both I and II are strong
questions.why: Both give a serious, relevant reason. GPSC JSO pre-screening, Jun 2026.

questions.q: In a row of 46 students, Sita is 14th from the left and Asha is 18th from the right. How many students sit between them?
Mukesh walks 6 km toward the South and then walks 3 km to his left. Finally, he turns to his right and walks 6 km. In which direction is he from the starting point?
questions.why: Facing south, left is east: net 12 km S and 3 km E, so South-East. GPSC CBRT, Nov 2023.

questions.q: In how many ways can the letters of the word LOGICAL be arranged?
questions.why: 7 letters with L twice: 7!/2! = 2520, not listed. GPSC's key said 5040, which ignores the repeated L. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.

questions.q: In a row of 58 students, Geeta is 21st from the left and Anil is 24th from the right. How many students sit between them?
If BEAUTY is coded as DHEZZF, how is FLOWER written?
questions.why: Shifts +2, +3, +4, +5, +6, +7 (wrapping round): F→H, L→O, O→S, W→B, E→K, R→Y. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.
